name: avista-mail
description: Email for Claude in Avista's Gmail, with links that stay real. The Gmail connector's create_draft, update_draft, reply and forward rewrite every link into an expiring google.com/url?q= redirect before saving the draft, and no input format gets past it; this plugin writes drafts through the Gmail API instead. A standard-library script creates, updates and threads reply drafts, appends the Gmail signature, and reads the stored draft back to confirm no wrapped links. It never sends. One-time setup per person: an OAuth Desktop client and a browser sign-in, with the refresh token kept in ~/.claude/.env and never printed.
